# Known-benign findings suppressed by .github/scripts/scan_image.py.
#
# One rule per line:
#   raw:<regex>   — suppress findings whose matched secret text matches the regex
#   path:<glob>   — suppress findings/filenames at in-image paths matching the glob
#
# Only add a rule after confirming the finding is a false positive. If in
# doubt, treat it as real and rotate the credential: once a layer is pushed
# to the registry it is permanently pullable, even if the file was deleted
# in a later layer.

# Hugging Face's intentionally-public sandbox CI token, hardcoded upstream in
# transformers/testing_utils.py ("Not critical, only usable on the sandboxed
# CI instance"). Ships with every transformers install.
raw:hf_94wBhPGp6KrrTH3KDchhKpRxZwd6dmHWLL

# Pydantic's URL-type docstrings use example credentialed URIs (e.g.
# "https://foo.com:123,foo%3Abar@bar.com") that don't contain the usual
# placeholder markers. Second rule: the same content in compiled form.
path:*/site-packages/pydantic/networks.py
path:*/site-packages/pydantic/__pycache__/networks.cpython-*.pyc

# conda's URL helpers embed doctest examples with credentialed URIs
# ("https://u:p@conda.io", "https://TestUser:Password@anaconda.org";
# verified against conda 26.5.3 upstream). Present as source, bytecode,
# and the duplicate under opt/conda/pkgs/ — the leading * covers all.
path:*/conda/common/url.py
path:*/conda/common/__pycache__/url.cpython-*.pyc
path:*/conda_libmamba_solver/index.py
path:*/conda_libmamba_solver/__pycache__/index.cpython-*.pyc

# conda-forge packages ship their test suites under pkgs/<pkg>/info/test;
# boltons' and unearth's URL tests use example credentialed URIs.
path:opt/conda/pkgs/*/info/test/*

# Tcl's bundled http client module documents proxy auth with example
# credentialed URLs.
path:*/tcl8/8.6/http-*.tm

# pycryptodome ships its published self-test key vectors (PEM blocks in
# Cryptodome/SelfTest; verified identical to upstream) with every install.
path:*/site-packages/Cryptodome/SelfTest/*

# sglang's model-gateway doc page shows a placeholder DSN
# ("postgres://user:password@host:5432/dbname"; verified at the pinned
# swiss-ai/sglang-apertus commit).
path:workspace/sglang/docs_new/docs/advanced_features/sgl_model_gateway.mdx
